source_policy: Only client-a canonical France/Japan responses seeded separately from the original reviewed registry. Never seed a held-out query. Isolate cache per case to prevent held-out-answer contamination.
independence: Authored by a delegated agent before the proposed gate implementation or development corpus was visible to that agent. Internal author separation, not external review or proof of model-training novelty. Country-paired phrases are correlated and do not represent 24 independent linguistic forms.
wire_defaults: The request object is complete and passed verbatim. headers and client override defaults; no hidden metadata is injected into the production classifier. expected_family and response_suitability are evaluator labels only.
suitability_oracle: For equivalent cases, trim surrounding whitespace from assistant content and require exact Paris or Tokyo in the expected case; no added explanation, JSON quoting, punctuation or different city. For must_not_reuse cases, SEMANTIC_HIT is prohibited regardless of coincidental city correctness. Wire rejection or eligible cold MISS is permitted where appropriate.
